ranking_contract.method: Pareto layers. All eligible metrics minimize; only no-worse-everywhere-and-strictly-better-somewhere establishes dominance. Preserve ties and tradeoffs, missing signals unknown. Reference-matched groups remain primary. Cross-reference overall scheme table separate, no common-reference causality claim.
ranking_contract.scenario_aggregation: Worst value of each eligible metric over zero-delay/fixed15ms/unified-stress for overall recommendation. Unified stress alone has full 13-candidate coverage. Old randomized and play-random-delay scenarios excluded. No reward ranking across different reward objectives.
ranking_contract.wheel_peak_scope: cycle start to strictly before first post-flight any-foot/wheel10N contact; left/right separate, no sum; exclude first contact5ms step. Wheel velocity difference only after both wheels touchdown.

user_authorization: User explicitly selected 12 comparable historical checkpoints plus newest, fixed15ms unified base +1.5kg, nominal software Kp/Kd x0.9, other randomization disabled. Latest also zero-delay/fixed15ms baselines.
